title: DeathPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `death` as the Core plugin exports it (decision 0144, PX-0). Block coordinates are whole numbers. The death place is x, y, z; each dropped stack is one drop_items record with its item name (the key without the minecraft: namespace), its count, and the death block where it falls. drops is the total count of dropped items and is absent when nothing dropped; drop_items is absent in the same case. respawn_* is the bed or world spawn point. Coordinates and respawn fields are absent when the server could not read them.

cause.description: The last damage cause (a Bukkit DamageCause name), or UNKNOWN.

dimension.description: The dimension the player died in: overworld, nether, end, or other for a custom one.

drops.description: The total count of items dropped, over every stack. Absent when nothing dropped.

drop_items.description: One record per dropped stack. Absent when nothing dropped.
